name: dire wolf

special_abilities.name: keen hearing and smell
special_abilities.desc: The wolf has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

special_abilities.name: pack tactics
special_abilities.desc: The wolf has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

lore:
The *Canis atrox*, or Dire Wolf, is a primordial echo of a colder age. Standing as tall as a mountain pony, these beasts are not merely oversized kin to the common wolf; they are the winter’s hunger given form. They haunt the frost-rimed taigas and the jagged mists of the High Peaks, where the air is thin and mercy thinner.

Their predatory brilliance lies in "The Long Stalk." Unlike the frantic chase of lesser hounds, the Dire Wolf pack employs a chilling, silent coordination. They maneuver their quarry into natural dead-ends—box canyons or treacherous ice-sheets—with the tactical precision of a veteran legion. A single howl is rarely a call for aid; it is a death knell for a hunt already won.

In local folklore, they are the "Heralds of the Eternal Frost." Mountain folk whisper that the Dire Wolf does not eat to satisfy hunger, but to swallow the sun. To see one’s reflection in their golden, unblinking eyes is to see the moment of your own passing. They remain the grim wardens of the high passes, ensuring that what enters the deep snows seldom returns.
